target: MoME/Foundation multimodal fusion (near-chance) — honest signal test

diagnosis.arg_surveillance: EXCLUDED — not real data. ARG targets are pseudo-labels: a fixed linear function of the model's own CLR-OTU input plus injected Gaussian noise (rng.normal(0,0.4-0.6)). Circular task; R2~0 is the noise floor, no external signal exists to recover.
diagnosis.mome_foundation_fusion: Trained on data/processed/synthetic_multimodal/ — modalities synthetically aligned (paired across site/times that never co-occurred). No real co-occurrence => no cross-modal structure => AUROC<0.5 on ~70 test samples. That data dir no longer exists; the near-chance numbers are an artifact, not a capability ceiling.

real_cooccurrence_task.name: microcystin (cyanotoxin) bimodal fusion
real_cooccurrence_task.why: The only SENTINEL data with REAL co-located modalities: satellite spectral (sf0..sf25) + in-situ pigment (CHLA,PC) at the same site/date, with an INDEPENDENT microcystin assay as label. Cyanotoxin is optically invisible => modalities are non-redundant.
real_cooccurrence_task.eval: GroupKFold(5) by site; pooled OOF AUROC; site-clustered bootstrap; permutation control

honest_verdict.summary: Real cross-modal signal EXISTS but is MODEST. On the genuinely co-occurring microcystin task (N=3649 co-located samples, 227 sites, from an INDEPENDENT toxin assay), a simple L2-logistic concat-fusion of REAL satellite + in-situ pigment beats the best single modality at every threshold (+0.026 to +0.034 AUROC), and the permutation control collapses the gain — so it is signal, not capacity. But under strict site-grouped CV the gain's site-clustered bootstrap CI excludes zero only at the detection threshold (mc>0.3, P=0.975); at the WHO thresholds the CI includes zero (data-limited: only 72-126 positive SITES, PC pigment 73% missing). Honest ceiling for this simple fusion: AUROC ~0.69. A stronger learner (GBM) was previously shown to reach ~0.79-0.82 on the same data, so ~0.69 is the linear-baseline floor, not the model ceiling. Crucially, the shipped MoME 0.42 / Foundation 0.37 were near chance NOT because fusion is hopeless but because they used SYNTHETICALLY aligned modalities (no real co-occurrence) — a data artifact. ARG surveillance is excluded entirely (circular pseudo-labels: targets manufactured from the model's own input).
